_comment: Golem Engine (Ardour 9.9, Linux): the plugin that plays each block type, by LV2 URI, VST3 class id (as Ardour's VST3 scanner reads it; golem/engine/run.sh scans before each start) or Ardour Lua DSP name. Read by bridge/engine/ardour_plan.py only (the REAPER path never reads it). Parameters are resolved like golem_rig.lua does: the catalog's parameter `name`, exact label first, then a case-insensitive substring of the Ardour label (labels measured on 2026-11-10: NAM 'Input Lvl', 'Output Lvl', 'Quality'; zeroconvolv 'Wet Signal Level'; Calf 'Time L', 'BPM', 'Feedback', 'Wet'; ACE 'Gain'). `files` = LV2 patch properties that carry a block's file (NAM model, IR). `loaded_output` = the plugin's output control that proves its file is loaded (> 0) when the plugin does not echo the file property back (sfizz: 'Number of regions', measured 2026-11-12); labels are read in the C locale (run.sh sets LC_ALL=C.UTF-8: sfizz's labels are translated otherwise). `drumkit` is two engine blocks: the translator (Lua DSP golem Drumtrans, port of golem_drumtrans.jsfx, its table written by the watcher) then the avldrums kit of the block's `kit_bank`; drumgizmo kits do not play here yet. `init` = values set ONCE when the plugin is added, before the block's parameters (golem_rig.lua FX_INIT: Calf chorus dry at unity, Surge XT Effects' FX Type). Proteus, Surge XT Effects, ZamGrains and Prisma are taken as VST3, as under REAPER: their LV2 builds expose no or other parameters (measured 2026-11-12, tools/check-engine-blocks.py). `absent` = catalog parameters with no control on this plugin, refused by the plan with the reason. Surge XT Effects (surge-spring, -freqshift, -treemonster) is out: its VST3 renames its controls after the FX type, the catalog's 'FX Parameter N' names do not resolve. A type absent from `effects` does not play on this engine yet (docs/ardour-plan.md §3: T1 blocks are added one by one in A3, T2 blocks come from golem-fx).

absent.zone_lo: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.zone_hi: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.transpose: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.arp: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet

volume.note: Interim, until golem-fx carries the volume block (T2): ACE Amplifier stops at -20 dB, so the heel of a volume pedal is not silence.

absent.wah: GxAutoWah has no such control (the same binary under REAPER: the knob does nothing there either)

absent.pos: ZamGrains 4 has no Grain Position control (VST3 and LV2)
